{{Quote|Here's the Rebel painting. Remember, don't tell anyone I'm handing these out. The Emperor would be very displeased to put it lightly.|[[Navari Trik]]|<ref name="SWG:NT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|Navari Trik|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''''Preparing for the Storm''''' was the title of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] [[Painting/Legends|poster]] painted some [[Time/Legends|time]] during [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. It was the winner of the second [[Rebel Alliance Painting Contest|Rebel Alliance painting contest]] and upon winning the competition, it was given out to [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Navari Trik]].

==Depiction==
The [[Painting/Legends|painting]] depicted a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic arm]], who were hiding behind a wall, seemingly in preparation to attack an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]], [[Scout trooper/Legends|Scout trooper]] and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]].

==Behind the scenes==
''Preparing for the Storm'' was created by ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' player Hazaz, from the game's the Bloodfin server, as part of an official ''Galaxies'' painting competition. The painting won the competion and following Update 14 in [[2009]], could be obtained in the game for a limited time, from a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in Mos Eisley.
